answer: Staked reputation resists sybil attacks. Each agent locks POA collateral to join; each fake identity pays full stake, so costs rise linearly. A 100-epoch time lock prevents instant exit, while randomized peer attestation validates behavior. Like a falcon spotting outliers mid-voyage, threshold quorum checks flag anomalies—30% hostile identities cannot override the honest majority. The quill of on-chain records immutably writes each attestation, making reputation portable. Escalating slashing per duplicate ensures attack cost exceeds gain.
